title: Origin-Agent-Cluster explicitly disables origin-keyed agent clustering
description: The response sets Origin-Agent-Cluster to ?0, which opts the document out of origin-keyed agent clustering. Documents that share a site but not an origin then run in the same agent cluster, so a compromised or hostile same-site document has a shorter path to the application's rendering process.
remediation: Send Origin-Agent-Cluster: ?1, or omit the header on browsers whose default is already origin-keyed. Keep ?0 only where a document genuinely depends on sharing an agent cluster with another origin, and record that dependency.
limitation: One header value. The rule reports the explicit opt-out; it cannot determine whether any same-site document actually shares the cluster in a deployment.
